blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The National Prosecution Service (NPS) has summoned Sen. Robinhood Padilla to appear before a panel of prosecutors and answer the obstruction of justice complaint filed against him. The complaint was filed by the Philippine National Police (PNP), represented by PCPT. Ericson C. Roc of the Anti-Organized Crime Unit under the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG-AOCU) in May following the supposed escape of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa in the early morning of May 14, hours after the Senate shooting incident. Padilla earlier admitted that dela Rosa hitched a ride with him as he was leaving the Senate […]...
